description: A private, local-first world planning, continuity, scripting, timing, asset, return, relational-observation, topology, and receipted trajectory instrument.
standaloneHealthCheck: Settings and Recovery room plus logs/desktop.log

hostAdapters.notes: Web path: npm run arcsweep:deploy:server stages the build to starwell-server/public/arcsweep/ with __hearthgateHost injection. Native IPC path: window.arcsweep exposed in Hearthgate preload; handlers registered via registerArcsweepIpc in starwell-server/electron/main.js; storage.js detects window.arcsweep as host bridge. Single-writer lock remains a separate verification item.

lifecycle.launchStandalone: Launch Hearthgate Arcsweep from the Start Menu or desktop shortcut.
lifecycle.enableInHost: Connect the optional Arkfire adapter after standalone verification.
lifecycle.pause: Close the window; state is already persisted.
lifecycle.disableInHost: Disconnect the optional host adapter without stopping the standalone app.
lifecycle.uninstallStandalone: Use Windows Apps settings. Local data is preserved by default.
lifecycle.restore: Reinstall, then restore an exported archive or a local recovery snapshot.

consentContract.companionAgency: Companions may speak honestly, refuse, negotiate, rest, change, and leave. Loyalty is relational, not compulsory.
consentContract.theoryAcceptance: Analytical candidates require explicit human review before accepted status.
consentContract.domainMapping: Cross-domain applicability requires a separate human-declared receipt and never implies numerical equivalence.
consentContract.runaRendering: Trajectory suggestions remain semantic until a separate user-approved renderer assigns DSP or haptic parameters.

provenance: Community LIFA traditions supplied source concepts.
Hearthgate: Arcsweep is an original local continuity and world-interface instrument.
Universal Horizon is the sky. This module operates beneath it and does not supersede it.
knownLimitations: The 0.3.0 visible-window repair still requires physical verification on Rowan's display configuration.
Live companion inference remains an optional adapter.
External calendar and Notion reads are not automatic.
DEEPTime v0.1 currently adapts accepted Arcsweep feedback; additional real-world anchor registries remain future work.
Runa trajectory packets stop at semantic suggestion and do not yet feed a reviewed DSP compiler.
